title: Renewal Loyalty Credit on Small Business Electricity Supply Agreements: Posting Conditions and Care System Tool
content:
An explicit renewal of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement accepted on or before the contract end date earns one renewal loyalty credit, in the amount of the renewal loyalty credit worked out for that renewal; an automatic renewal earns none.

## When the credit is fixed and posted

1. The loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement shows a renewal election marked accepted, dated earlier than the day its renewed term begins.
2. The loyalty credit is worked out only once every billed cycle of the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date carries the multi-site credit due on it.
3. The loyalty credit is not posted until every other agreement of the business that stands drop pending or closed with an early termination fee owed carries that fee on its bill.
4. The loyalty credit is posted against the agreement's latest billed cycle and carries that cycle's first day as its billing cycle.

These are conditions on the records: each is read from the agreement record, the agreement's bill lines and the business's other agreements as they stand on the handling date.

## Business effect

A renewal loyalty credit line is added to the renewed agreement's bill, tied to its latest billed cycle, as a reduction of the amount billed. The business sees the loyalty credit on the statement of that cycle.

## Tool: `post_renewal_loyalty_credit_e53d7f06`

**Use and capability.** Posts the renewal loyalty bill credit on a small business electricity agreement: a new credit line is added to the agreement's bill, tied to the billing cycle named, with the credit amount entered as a reduction of the amount billed and today's posting date.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `post_renewal_loyalty_credit_e53d7f06` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bizpower_agreement_id` | the agreement number of the renewed small business electricity agreement, as shown on the agreement record returned by the agreement lookup | identifier |
| `billing_period_start` | the start date of the billing cycle on whose bill the credit appears | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the size of the credit in USD; the tool records it as a reduction of the bill | positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `billing_line_id` (the new credit line's reference), `agreement_id`, `line` (`renewal_loyalty_credit`), `cycle_start` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount_usd` (the signed line amount, negative, 2 decimals) and `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `billing_line_id` means the credit is on the bill.
